newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli woman, 80, finally gets driver's licence.
newsitem.headline: Israeli woman, 80, finally gets driver's licence.

text.p: Shulamit Dohzin's long road to a driver's licence has come to a happy end -- the 80-year-old Israeli woman passed her driving test on the 34th try.

"She'll never be a race car driver but this time she finally proved she won't be a danger to others on the road," Yitzhak Ordman, head of the licencing bureau in the port city of Ashdod, told Reuters on Tuesday.

Dohzin told Israeli newspapers she first tried for a licence 32 years ago so she could drive to Jaffa, about 30 km (19 miles) away to visit her parents. She took more than 600 driving lessons, costing some $24,000.
"They're dead now but I will be able to drive with my grandchildren," she said.
